_note: Chip classification on FAIR-CSAR SL, 22 classes (DESIGN.md section 4). METHOD, the backbone, the budget and the split are filled in by finetune_chips.py. data and train values are the SARDet_chips values (themselves the A0/A1 ATRNet values) so the recipe is the same across the three chip tests; only the chips and the head size differ.

train.selection: epoch with the highest mean per-class accuracy on the selection chips (earliest on ties)
